Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! I'm Emma Johnson, and I'm so glad to hear you'll be joining our team in the marketing department.

I wanted to reach out and say hello before your first day. If you have any questions or need anything as you settle in, please don't hesitate to reach out. I'm looking forward to working with you!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
